description: Browse your Audiobookshelf libraries and keep listening progress, bookmarks and playlists in sync
name: io.github.ni-c/audiobookshelf-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Audiobookshelf instance, e.g. https://abs.example.com
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOBOOKSHELF_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key from Settings -> Users -> API Keys (Audiobookshelf 2.26.0 or newer)
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOBOOKSHELF_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the 29 read tools and no write tools
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOBOOKSHELF_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept self-signed certificates for this connection only
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOBOOKSHELF_INSECURE_TLS

title: Audiobookshelf
